id: 31_Test Your Basic Safety Knowledge Work at Height Crane Safety Scaffolding Safety
title: 高处作业：争取一次过关
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/31_Test Your Basic Safety Knowledge Work at Height Crane Safety Scaffolding Safety.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/31_Test Your Basic Safety Knowledge Work at Height Crane Safety Scaffolding Safety/src.py

points.K6: 救援计划为了尽快救人

shots.scene: 欣欣站在梯子旁，举起一张空白答卷
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a step ladder holding up a blank answer sheet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 高处作业小测验，看看能不能一次过关！
overlay: 高处作业：争取一次过关

shots.scene: 阿杰坐在电脑前，屏幕上一排空白主题卡片
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a computer whose screen shows a row of blank topic cards.
shots.narration: 阿杰打开安全知识在线考试。

shots.scene: 阿杰挑中梯子图标的卡片
shots.prompt_en: The young male student clicks a card with a ladder icon on the screen.
shots.narration: 他选了高处作业这一套。

shots.scene: 一排主题卡片：射线、水压、化学品、脚手架、施工、电气
shots.prompt_en: A row of topic cards: a radiation trefoil, a pressure gauge, a chemical bottle, scaffolding, a crane hook and a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 射线、水压、化学品、脚手架、施工、电气。

shots.scene: 第二排卡片：工作场所、梯子、起重机、受限空间、火焰、土坑
shots.prompt_en: A second row of topic cards: a factory, a ladder, a crane, a manhole, a flame and a trench. No people.
shots.narration: 还有工作场所、高处、起重、受限空间、消防、开挖。

shots.scene: 空白测验框：十格进度条和计时器
shots.prompt_en: A blank quiz panel with ten progress segments and a countdown timer. No people.
shots.narration: 每套十题十分钟，答对八题才算过。

shots.scene: 一大群人只有少数打勾
shots.prompt_en: A crowd of small person icons where only a few have green checks above them. No people.
shots.narration: 几百人考过，第一次就过的只有18人。

shots.scene: 测验框上方一页空白文章，阿杰直接往下拉
shots.prompt_en: Above the quiz panel there is a blank article page, and the young male student scrolls past it.
shots.narration: 测验上面有一篇文章，阿杰没看。

shots.scene: 三个图标：坠落的人、断裂的挂钩、风雨云
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a falling person, a broken hook and a wind and rain cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 文章讲高处作业的风险。

shots.scene: 老李站在梯子上，窗外刮风
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands on a ladder indoors while strong wind blows outside the window.
shots.narration: 人会坠落，设备会失效，环境也会添乱。

shots.scene: 四张卡片：高楼、夜晚月亮、警示三角、雨伞
shots.prompt_en: Four cards: a tall building, a night moon, a warning triangle and an umbrella. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：什么时候要防坠落保护？

shots.scene: 高楼、月亮、雨伞三张卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: The tall building, night moon and umbrella cards are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不是只在高楼、夜里或下雨才要。

shots.scene: 人站在平台边缘，旁边护栏和安全带图标
shots.prompt_en: A person icon near a platform edge, with a guardrail icon and a harness icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 只要有从高处坠落的风险，就要防护。

shots.scene: 价格标签、颜色色卡、卷尺图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A price tag icon, a color swatch icon and a tape measure icon, all crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：选梯子要考虑什么？

shots.scene: 四个图标：高度尺、砝码、材质块、任务卡
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a height ruler, a weight, a material sample block and a task card. No people.
shots.narration: 高度、承重、材质，还有干什么活。

shots.scene: 老李对着梯子比划要干的活
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer looks at a ladder and points up at the task he needs to do.
shots.narration: 不是只看价钱、颜色或者长短。

shots.scene: 老李检查安全带的织带和挂钩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the webbing and hook of a full body harness.
shots.narration: 第三题：防坠落装备多久查一次？

shots.scene: 一年、半年、坏了才查的日历图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Calendar icons for yearly and half-yearly checks and a broken icon, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不是一年、半年，也不是坏了才查。

shots.scene: 空白说明书和带勾的检查记录
shots.prompt_en: A blank manufacturer manual and a blank inspection record with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 每次用前查，再按厂家建议定期查。

shots.section_title: 救援计划为了尽快救人
shots.scene: 老李挂在安全带上，悬在半空
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hangs from his harness lanyard below a beam after a fall, holding still.
shots.narration: 第四题：为什么要有救援计划？
overlay: 救援计划为了尽快救人

shots.section_title: 救援计划为了尽快救人
shots.scene: 炫耀、盖章、多加小心三个图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: a person showing off, a stamp on a form and a caution hand. No people.
shots.narration: 不是做给领导看，也不只为合规。

shots.section_title: 救援计划为了尽快救人
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员推来移动平台把老李接下
shots.prompt_en: The security officer brings a mobile platform and helps the facility engineer down safely.
shots.narration: 是为了出事时迅速、安全地把人救下。

shots.scene: 阿杰的屏幕显示一个大大的20%和红叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at his screen showing a large red cross and a low score bar.
shots.narration: 阿杰随手乱选，只得了20%。

shots.scene: 结果页逐题显示正确选项
shots.prompt_en: A result page lists each question with the correct option highlighted in green. No people.
shots.narration: 结果页会告诉你每题的正确答案。

shots.scene: 阿杰认真翻看那篇文章
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scrolls back up and reads the article carefully.
shots.narration: 第一次答题前，先把文章读一遍。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，一排图标：文章、护栏、梯子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard with icons of an article, a guardrail and a ladder.
shots.narration: 先读材料；有坠落风险就防护；选梯看四样。

shots.scene: 检查表和救援平台图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a checklist and a mobile rescue platform. No people.
shots.narration: 装备用前查，救援计划为救人。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye next to the ladder.
shots.narration: 先学再考，争取一次过关，下次见！
